name: Video Trim
summary: Trims a video clip to a user-defined start and end time range. Auto-detects source duration and outputs the specified segment.
executionNotes: Extracts a subsegment of video from startTime to endTime (both in seconds). Duration is auto-detected from the source video metadata and displayed in the node UI. Processing is entirely browser-based using MediaSource API and canvas rendering. Progress (0-100) tracks the encoding operation. encoderSupported flag indicates codec compatibility. Preserves original video resolution and bitrate where possible.

exampleConnections.scenario: Trim generated Veo video to a specific 30-second segment.
Feed trimmed clips into a video stitching node for sequencing.
